card.title: {name} usage
card.caption: {used}% used · {left}% left
card.signin.title: Open {tool} to sign in again
card.signin.body: Droplet reads the sign-in {tool} already has. Sign in there and this card fills in on the next refresh.
card.nosub.title: No subscription
card.nosub.body: This account has no plan with usage limits, so there is nothing to track.
card.error.title: Couldn't read usage
card.error.body: {error}. Droplet will try again on the next refresh.
card.waiting.title: Reading usage…
card.waiting.body: The first reading is on its way.
card.ratelimited: The service asked Droplet to slow down. Next try in {time}.
fc.out_at: At this pace: out at {at} ({time} before reset)
fc.out_in: At this pace: out in {in} ({time} before reset)
fc.stale: Forecast paused until fresh data arrives
notch.grip: Hold and drag. Double-click to recentre.
notch.locked.title: Position is locked
notch.locked.body: Unlock it from the right-click menu or Settings › Notch.
firstrun.title: Droplet is running
firstrun.body: Its ring lives in the tray. On Windows 11, open the ^ overflow and drag it next to the clock to keep it visible.
win.title: Droplet Settings
s.general.start_with_windows.label: Start with Windows
s.general.start_with_windows.desc: Droplet opens quietly in the background when you sign in.
s.general.app_icon.label: App icon
s.general.app_icon.desc: Hidden removes Droplet from the tray. Reach settings from the gear under the notch, or with your shortcut.
s.general.language.label: Language
s.general.language.desc: Language for the notch, cards and this window.
s.general.refresh_minutes.label: Refresh every
s.general.refresh_minutes.desc: How often Droplet re-reads usage. Shorter is fresher, longer is lighter on your PC.
s.general.shortcut.label: Shortcut to show the card
s.general.shortcut.desc: Opens the usage card for the tool closest to its limit.
s.general.shortcut.taken: That shortcut is already used by Windows or another app. Try a different one.
s.general.shortcut.need_modifier: Use at least one of Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win with a key.
s.general.tray_icons.label: Tray icons
s.general.tray_icons.desc: Small rings in the tray, next to the clock.
acc.info: This app never signs you in. It reads the sign-in your tools already have. To connect, sign in to the tool itself.
acc.empty.title: No AI tools found yet
acc.empty.body: Install and sign in to any of these, then press Refresh. Droplet checks again every few minutes.
acc.no_file: That file does not exist yet
acc.drag: Reorder {name}. Alt + arrow keys move it.
acc.agy.label: agy.exe location
acc.agy.desc: Set this if Antigravity is installed somewhere unusual.
pv.hover: Live preview · point here to expand
s.appearance.theme.label: Theme
s.appearance.theme.desc: System follows your Windows light or dark setting.
s.appearance.size.label: Size
s.appearance.show_remaining.label: Show remaining instead of used
s.appearance.show_remaining.desc: The label shows what’s left. The ring still fills by what’s used.
s.appearance.weekly_ring.label: Weekly ring
s.appearance.weekly_ring.desc: A thin second ring for the weekly limit, on tools that have one.
s.appearance.pace_tick.label: Pace tick on rings
s.appearance.pace_tick.desc: A small mark where an even pace would be right now. Past the mark means you are using it faster than the window allows.
s.appearance.color_mode.label: Color transition
s.appearance.color_mode.desc: Hard step changes color at each level. Smooth ramp blends between them.
s.appearance.warn_at.label: Warning at
s.appearance.warn_at.desc: Rings turn amber from this point.
s.appearance.crit_at.label: Critical at
s.appearance.crit_at.desc: Rings turn red and show “!” from this point.
s.appearance.colors.label: Usage colors
s.appearance.glyphs.label: Provider glyphs
s.appearance.glyphs.desc: Monochrome keeps the notch calm. Color tints each logo.
s.appearance.motion.label: Motion
s.appearance.motion.desc: Reduced turns off stretch, wobble and jiggle, and keeps short fades.
s.appearance.spring_feel.label: Spring feel
s.appearance.spring_feel.desc: How bouncy the notch is when it opens, lands and settles.
s.notch.show.label: Show
s.notch.show.desc: On hover keeps a slim tab at the edge until you point at it.
s.notch.edge.label: Edge
s.notch.edge.desc: You can also drag it there.
s.notch.screen.label: Screen
s.notch.screen.desc: Which monitor the notch lives on.
s.notch.position.label: Position
s.notch.position.desc: Hold the dots under the settings button and drag. It follows the nearest edge.
s.notch.locked.label: Lock position
s.notch.locked.desc: Stops dragging, so the notch can’t be moved by accident.
s.notch.hide_fullscreen.label: Hide for full-screen apps
s.notch.hide_fullscreen.desc: Steps out of the way of games, videos and presentations.
s.notch.collapse_after_min.label: Collapse to tab after
s.notch.collapse_after_min.desc: After this long without use, the notch shrinks to a slim tab.
s.notch.hover_delay_ms.label: Hover delay
s.notch.hover_delay_ms.desc: How long to point at a ring before its card opens.
s.notch.high_contrast.label: High-contrast tab outline
s.notch.high_contrast.desc: Outlines the collapsed tab so it is easy to find on any wallpaper.
s.alerts.warning.label: Notify at warning level ({pct}%)
s.alerts.warning.desc: When any tool crosses the warning level.
s.alerts.critical.label: Notify at critical level ({pct}%)
s.alerts.critical.desc: When any tool crosses the critical level.
s.alerts.run_out.label: You’ll run out before reset
s.alerts.run_out.desc: Warns when your current pace would use up a limit before it resets.
s.alerts.run_out_lead_min.label: Warn me if it’s at least
s.alerts.run_out_lead_min.desc: Ignores close calls. Only warns when you would run out this much before the reset.
s.alerts.reset.label: Quota reset
s.alerts.reset.desc: When a limit resets and you have full room again.
s.alerts.reset_soon.label: Resets in 10 minutes
s.alerts.reset_soon.desc: A heads-up shortly before a limit resets.
s.alerts.show_as.label: Show as
s.alerts.show_as.desc: A peek extends the notch for a few seconds. Notifications also land in the Notification Center.
s.alerts.sound.label: Sound
s.alerts.quiet.enabled.label: Quiet hours
s.alerts.quiet.enabled.desc: No alerts between these times. The notch still updates.
s.forecast.show.label: Show forecast in card
s.forecast.show.desc: Adds a line like “At this pace: out at 16:20” to each usage card.
s.forecast.pace_window_min.label: Pace based on the last
s.forecast.pace_window_min.desc: Shorter reacts quickly to bursts. Longer is steadier.
s.forecast.suggest.label: Suggest switching tools
s.forecast.suggest.desc: When a tool is close to its limit, a “Use this one now” chip appears on the notch and points to the tool with the most room left.
s.forecast.hysteresis_pts.label: Switch only if the other tool has at least
s.forecast.hysteresis_pts.desc: Percentage points more room. Keeps the chip from flip-flopping between tools that are close.
s.history.retention_days.label: Keep usage history
s.history.retention_days.desc: Used for sparklines, pace and the weekly summary. Stored only on this PC.
s.history.data.label: Your history
s.history.data.desc: Export as a spreadsheet, or delete everything stored so far.
s.history.weekly_summary.label: Weekly summary every Monday
s.history.weekly_summary.desc: A short recap of last week’s usage per tool, as a Windows notification.
s.history.netlog.label: Network log
s.history.netlog.desc: Every request this app made (time, site, result). Never passwords or tokens.
privacy.read_only: Your sign-ins are only read, never stored or changed
confirm.clear.title: Clear usage history?
confirm.clear.body: This deletes the usage history stored on this PC. Sparklines and pace start fresh. This can’t be undone.
s.about.version.label: Version
s.about.version.desc: Opens the releases page in your browser.
s.about.license.label: License
s.about.source.label: Source code
s.about.diagnostics.label: Diagnostics
s.about.diagnostics.desc: Versions, settings and which files were found. No tokens or sign-ins.
s.about.config.label: Config file
